description: Systems wiring — connect existing game systems, add missing infrastructure. All logic-only, no visual/rendering changes.

userStories.title: Skill tree auto-XP award middleware
userStories.description: Create middleware that automatically awards skill tree XP when players complete relevant activities. Quiz completions award reading/writing/grammar XP based on quiz type. Battle wins award magic XP. Conversation practice awards conversation XP. Pronunciation drills award pronunciation XP.
acceptanceCriteria: src/store/middleware/skillTreeXpMiddleware.js listens for quiz, battle, conversation, pronunciation actions
Quiz completion: awards XP to matching skill tree (reading quiz → reading tree, grammar quiz → grammar tree)
Battle win: awards magic tree XP scaled by opponent difficulty
Conversation practice: awards conversation tree XP scaled by score
Pronunciation drill: awards pronunciation tree XP
XP amounts configurable via constants (not hardcoded in middleware)
Tests: 14+ tests covering each activity type, XP scaling, edge cases
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read skillTreeSlice.js for addSkillXP action. Check quiz/battle/conversation action types in their respective slices. Follow middleware patterns from vocabRateMiddleware.

userStories.title: Faction rewards and reputation gates
userStories.description: Wire faction alignment to tangible gameplay rewards. Each faction tier (Novice→Hero) unlocks specific bonuses: shop discounts, exclusive recipes, bonus XP multipliers, and zone access. Create a gate-checking system that other systems can query.
acceptanceCriteria: getFactionRewards(factionId, tier) returns array of unlocked rewards for that tier
Reward types: shopDiscount (5-25%), exclusiveRecipes (IDs), xpMultiplier (1.1-1.5x), zoneAccess (zone IDs)
checkFactionGate(factionId, requiredTier, playerState) returns true/false
Faction rewards data defined for all 6 factions across 5 tiers (30 reward sets)
selectFactionBonuses(state) memoized selector returns active bonuses from primary+secondary factions
Tests: 14+ tests covering reward lookup, gate checking, bonus stacking
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read factionSlice.js and factions.js. Tiers: Novice(0-19), Initiate(20-39), Ally(40-59), Champion(60-79), Hero(80-100). Pure functions + selectors, no middleware needed.

userStories.title: Companion leveling and ability system
userStories.description: Build companion progression: companions earn XP from battles and exploration, level up (max 20), and unlock abilities at specific levels. Each companion has a unique ability tree (3 abilities unlocked at levels 5, 10, 15).
acceptanceCriteria: addCompanionXP(companionId, xp) awards XP with auto-level-up at thresholds
Level thresholds: level N requires N*100 cumulative XP (level 5 = 500 XP)
Each companion has 3 abilities unlocked at levels 5, 10, 15
getCompanionAbilities(companionId, level) returns unlocked abilities
Ability data for all 12 companions (36 abilities total) defined in data file
companionXpMiddleware awards XP when companion participates in battle
Tests: 14+ tests covering XP, leveling, ability unlock, all companions
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read companionSlice.js for existing state. Companion IDs and data in companion files. Add companionAbilities.js data file. Middleware should listen for battle end actions where companion participated.

userStories.title: Notification queue system
userStories.description: Replace the single-slot notification with a priority queue. Notifications are queued with type, priority, and duration. Higher priority notifications display first. Queue persists across renders and drains one at a time.
acceptanceCriteria: src/store/slices/notificationSlice.js with queue array, activeNotification, and history
enqueueNotification({ type, message, priority, duration, data }) adds to queue
Priority levels: critical(3), high(2), normal(1), low(0) — higher shows first
dismissNotification() removes active, promotes next from queue
Notification types: achievement, reward, levelUp, questUpdate, system, warning
selectActiveNotification(state) returns highest-priority queued item
History keeps last 50 dismissed notifications
Tests: 14+ tests covering queue ordering, priority, dismiss, history, overflow
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read uiSlice.js for existing notification state. This replaces uiSlice notification with a dedicated slice. Don't break existing showNotification dispatches — add backward compat.

userStories.title: FSRS leech detection and suspension
userStories.description: Add leech detection to the FSRS system. Words that have lapsed 5+ times are flagged as leeches. Leeches get special treatment: shorter intervals, tagged for focused review. Players can suspend problematic cards to remove them from rotation temporarily.
acceptanceCriteria: isLeech(card) returns true if lapses >= 5
getLeechCards(allCards) returns all leeched cards sorted by lapse count
suspendCard(wordId) removes card from review rotation until unsuspended
unsuspendCard(wordId) returns card to rotation with reset interval
Leech cards get 50% shorter intervals (more frequent review)
selectLeechCount(state) and selectSuspendedCards(state) selectors
Middleware: auto-flag leeches after each review and adjust scheduling
Tests: 14+ tests covering detection, suspension, interval adjustment, unsuspend
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read vocabularySlice.js for card state (lapses field from FSRS). Read fsrs.js service. Add suspended field to card state. Middleware listens for vocabulary/reviewCard actions.

userStories.title: Crafting recipe discovery flow
userStories.description: Create a system where players discover recipes through gameplay: NPCs teach recipes at friendship thresholds, quests reward recipes, and experimenting with ingredients can reveal hidden recipes. Track discovery state per profession.
acceptanceCriteria: getDiscoverableRecipes(professionId, playerState) returns recipes player can currently discover
Discovery sources: npcFriendship (NPC at relationship 50+), questReward (quest completion), experimentation (combine 3 unknown ingredients)
Each recipe has a discoveryMethod field in recipe data
discoverRecipe(professionId, recipeId, method) action tracks how it was found
selectUndiscoveredRecipeCount(professionId) selector for UI hints
experimentWithIngredients(ingredient1, ingredient2, ingredient3) returns recipe or null
Tests: 12+ tests covering each discovery method, experiment logic, state tracking
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read craftingSlice.js, recipes.js, and professions.js. Add discoveryMethod to recipe data. Experimentation uses ingredient category matching, not exact IDs.

userStories.title: Daily repeatable quest generator
userStories.description: Build a service that generates 3 daily quests each UTC day. Quest types: review N words, win N battles, craft an item, visit a zone, gift an NPC. Quests scale to player level. Completing all 3 awards a bonus chest.
acceptanceCriteria: generateDailyQuests(playerState, dateString) returns 3 deterministic quests (same date = same quests per player)
Quest types: vocab_review (review X words), battle_win (win X battles), craft_item, visit_zone, gift_npc
Difficulty scales: low-level players get easier targets (review 10 words), high-level harder (review 50)
dailyQuestMiddleware checks completion on relevant actions and marks quests done
Bonus reward dispatched when all 3 daily quests complete
Daily quests reset at UTC midnight
Tests: 14+ tests covering generation, determinism, scaling, completion, reset
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Use player level + date hash for deterministic generation. Follow vocabRateMiddleware pattern for UTC midnight reset. Store daily quest state in a new dailyQuestSlice or extend dailyGoalsSlice.

userStories.title: Item rarity tiers and vendor selling
userStories.description: Add rarity tiers to items (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary) with sell prices. Players can sell items to vendors for currency. Sell price scales with rarity. Vendors have buy-back for last 10 sold items.
acceptanceCriteria: Item rarity enum: common, uncommon, rare, epic, legendary with color codes
Each item in equipment data has a rarity field and sellPrice
sellItem(itemId, quantity) removes from inventory, adds currency to economy
Sell price multipliers: common=1x, uncommon=2x, rare=5x, epic=15x, legendary=50x of base
buyBackHistory stores last 10 sold items with original price + 20% markup
buyBackItem(index) repurchases from history
selectSellableItems(state) filters inventory for non-equipped, non-locked items
Tests: 12+ tests covering sell, currency gain, buyback, rarity pricing, edge cases
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read inventorySlice.js and economySlice.js. Add rarity to equipment.js data. Sell dispatches to economySlice for currency. Keep buyback in inventorySlice.

userStories.title: Analytics event emission middleware
userStories.description: Create middleware that auto-emits analytics events for key player actions. Events queued locally and batch-sent when server is available. Covers session lifecycle, quiz completions, battle outcomes, feature usage, and progression milestones.
acceptanceCriteria: analyticsMiddleware listens for key Redux actions and emits structured events
Event types: session_start, session_end, quiz_completed, battle_finished, level_up, achievement_unlocked, feature_used, zone_entered
Each event has: type, timestamp, sessionId, properties (action-specific data)
Events queued in analyticsSlice (max 500, FIFO overflow)
flushAnalytics() sends queued events to server (or no-ops if offline)
Session ID generated on app start, included in all events
Tests: 14+ tests covering event emission, queue, overflow, flush, session tracking
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read server/src/models/AnalyticsEvent.js for event schema. Create analyticsSlice.js for queue state. Middleware pattern: intercept actions, don't block them. Server endpoint already exists at /api/analytics.

userStories.title: Audio ducking and SFX queue
userStories.description: Add audio ducking (BGM volume auto-reduces during dialogue/pronunciation) and an SFX queue that prevents sound overlap. Max 3 concurrent SFX; additional sounds wait in queue. BGM ducks to 30% during voice, restores with fade.
acceptanceCriteria: duckBGM(targetVolume, fadeDuration) smoothly reduces BGM volume
restoreBGM(fadeDuration) smoothly restores to previous volume
Auto-duck triggers when playWordPronunciation or playLetterPronunciation called
SFX queue: max 3 concurrent sounds, additional queued FIFO
queueSfx(sfxName, priority) with priority override (high-priority SFX skip queue)
clearSfxQueue() stops all queued sounds
Ducking state tracked (prevent double-duck if multiple pronunciations play)
Tests: 12+ tests covering ducking, restore, SFX queue limits, priority, concurrent cap
npm run test:run passes
userStories.notes: Read src/services/audio.js (AudioManager singleton). Extend existing class, don't replace it. Howler.js supports volume fading natively via .fade(). Test with mock Howl instances.
